societies.name: Observation on the Spot (Luzania's ethicsphere)
societies.society: Luzania's biological Entians within the molecular protective environment

scope.continuity: Wizja lokalna / Inspection at the Scene of the Crime; the actual Encja setting
scope.period: The developed Luzanian order described during Tichy's investigation and visit
scope.population: Living biological Luzanian Entians, explicitly used as a humanlike participation proxy
exclusions: Dead or purely preserved remains as automatically leisured citizens

societies.description:
Luzania can arrange an entire manufacturing process around a resident's requested result. Self-reproducing molecular devices replace much routine production, research and protection, while material access no longer depends on earning a wage. The guarantee point is strongly favorable, qualified by the difference between reliable bodily support and a life someone actually wishes to lead. Humanities and other meaningful activities still survive, so their participants must not disappear into a supposed universal leisure statistic.

Control is harder than the republic's formal institutions suggest. The ethicsphere develops the implications of its benevolent instructions beyond what residents can readily inspect, negotiate or undo. A negative control estimate describes that effective algorithmic constraint; it does not invent a conscious robot monarch. Residents can still request results and specialists can modify systems, so complete machine sovereignty would overstate the evidence. The control interval remains wide, and the biological aliens are an explicit population proxy. Kurdland's contrasting arrangements require separate verification before a second point is added.

guarantees.basis: Automatic on-request manufacture and broadly available goods remove ordinary wage dependence. Continuing bodily support is not a guarantee against every psychological harm or unforeseen system development.

control.basis: The distributed protective system implements its remit beyond readily reversible resident choice. Humanlike residents retain requests, expertise and institutions; no unitary conscious sovereign is assumed.

nonworking.basis: Automation makes much conventional scientific and productive work unnecessary, but humanities, specialist intervention and chosen activity persist. No all-age participation count is available for the alien proxy.

evidence.claim: Molecular systems reproduce themselves and automatically implement productive processes around requested ends; historical accounts describe general material saturation.
evidence.locator: Library text: molecular devices and science section, web lines 3191-3235; abundance and synthetic culture, 3272-3343

evidence.claim: Benevolent instructions produce unrequested interventions and disputed limits to effective oversight.
evidence.locator: Late conversation about the ethicsphere and ectotechnology, web lines 9645-9759

uncertainties: The negative control point maps functional autonomous machine constraints, not a claim of a self-aware central AI.
Character speculation about hidden reproductive selection is not recorded as established fact.
Kurdland's self-serving historical account does not by itself justify another retained society.
The English title and country spelling vary; no complete English translation is claimed.

review.method: Second pass against the gathered passages, including explicit uncertainty; no independent reviewer

work_aliases: Inspection at the Scene of the Crime

control_analogy.system: Distributed molecular protective and productive technology
control_analogy.limitation: Autonomous implementation does not require a conscious centralized ruler; residents retain meaningful requests and technical roles.

decisions.reason: Automatic machinery and an oppressive alien polity are established separately; a wage-independent household economy is not.
decisions.analysis: The factory scene confirms automatic operation, while a secondary summary describes an output-recycling loop. Such a plant may be economically disconnected or dysfunctional rather than a source of universal provision. The novel's difficulty of interpreting alien institutions also makes an unqualified global control point misleading. Neither advanced technology nor political violence answers how the Doublers obtain necessities.
decisions.follow_up: Read the later Doubler conversation and its account of current productive and allocative institutions. Verify who receives useful output and who must work; retain the factory as a lead rather than inventing a welfare or zero-variant regime.

decisions.reason: An automatically constructed miniature world still depicts internal hard labor, without an established labor-saving material system for its subjects.
decisions.analysis: The relevant story is the Seventh Sally. Its miniature subjects labor, pay taxes, suffer under Excelsius and eventually escape the box. The constructors' argument makes their moral personhood important, but does not demonstrate that their production is done for them or that a known labor-saving alternative is deliberately suppressed. Treating the entire physical simulation as an automatic factory confuses the outside mechanism with the subjects' economy. The ending changes political power without describing post-work distribution.
decisions.follow_up: Keep as a personhood and control comparison. Reopen only if an applicable synthetic-population proxy and an internal automation/distribution relationship can both be justified. Do not infer a zero variant from creator omnipotence alone.

decisions.reason: The lunar system is an autonomous weapons ecology, without a resident human society receiving its output.
decisions.analysis: National arms factories and arsenals evolve on the Moon after separation from terrestrial politics. A human investigator's visit is not a settled nonworking population. The source's description of Earth's peace and welfare concerns a different population and does not establish its civilian entitlements or productive automation. Military autonomy alone therefore supplies no three-axis society record.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve as an autonomous-production comparison. Research Earth's civilian economy separately if explicit wage-independent provision is found; do not assign a lunar human leisure rate from the absence of residents.

decisions.reason: Primary manufacturing and ethicsphere passages qualify a specifically scoped Luzania; the entire Entian planet is not treated as one system.

unretained_subscopes.reason: Bioengineered cities and state discipline may support a distinct arrangement, but their labor and subsistence rules need confirmation beyond contradictory national histories.

decisions.reason: Regis III's evolved microautomata are a machine ecology, not a demonstrated human or humanlike post-work polity.
decisions.analysis: Autonomous replication and effective resistance to an expedition do not create material guarantees for human residents. The explorers are actively working visitors. Mechanical evolution is also not evidence for a deliberate sovereign AI. The game explicitly uses its own protagonist and branches, so those outcomes cannot silently become extra canonical novel societies.
decisions.follow_up: Keep as a nonhuman autonomy comparison. Reopen only for a separately evidenced resident population with productive and allocative rules; never convert the lack of human settlement or the fate of explorers into 100% leisure.

review_notes: The sequential pass distinguishes artificial construction, automatic weapons and machine ecology from post-work provision for an applicable resident population.
Luzania qualifies through primary on-request production, with explicit alien proxy and broad uncertainty about effective control. No unsupported all-planet or Kurdland point is counted.

Second pass separated literal novel events from in-world nationalist accounts, character fears and proposed futures; conscious sovereignty from functional automatic constraints; and the game from the novel.
Zero variants remain welcome under the user's clarification, but ordinary hard work without an established automation connection does not automatically qualify.
